Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Shag Diamond Morrocan Area Rug, 2' 2" x 4", Cream
Colors: Cream
Materials: Polypropylene
100% Polypropylene Imported Whimsical meets cosmopolitan with this luxuriously plush shag runner. The Morrocan tribal-inspired charcoal design gives it a natural feel that will be a perfect addition to either rustic-chic or contemporary styles. 2'2" x 8'1" 100% Polypropylene Powerloomed construction in India High pile height makes it plush and cozy Vacuum, professionally clean Pair with a rug pad, which is sold separately Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
